## NYT::NFlow::EKafkaDeliveryGuarantee {#NYT_NFlow_EKafkaDeliveryGuarantee}

#|
|| Possible values | **Description** ||
|| `at_least_once` | Records are written by an idempotent producer, which drops retries within one session. Messages a restart replays may be written again. ||
|| `exactly_once` | Records are written in Kafka transactions together with a progress marker, and a restart does not write the replayed messages that are already committed again, unless `allow_missing_progress_marker` lets a sink partition start without a trusted marker. Consumers must read with `isolation.level=read_committed`. ||
|#
